## Code Review

This pull request adds a definition and a reference test for the `fused_add_rmsnorm_h8192` operation, updating its status in the model coverage documentation. The feedback highlights that the current implementation and tests do not account for the in-place update of the residual tensor performed by the FlashInfer kernel, which could lead to incorrect results during model execution or tracing.
